create_PromptEncoder: create a PromptEncoder to encode point, box, and mask prompts for SAM's mask decoder
embed_PromptEncoder_points: embed point prompts with coordinates and labels into sparse embeddings using PromptEncoder._embed_points
embed_PromptEncoder_boxes: embed box prompts into sparse corner embeddings using PromptEncoder._embed_boxes
embed_PromptEncoder_masks: embed mask inputs into dense spatial embeddings using PromptEncoder._embed_masks
generate_PositionEmbeddingRandom_encodin: generate random spatial positional encodings for a grid or set of coordinates using PositionEmbeddingRandom
